contract.title: 2-D forward step, Mach 2.0, h = 0.2, x = 0.6
contract.requested_prompt: Simulate a 2D forward-facing step with inlet Mach number 2.0, step height 0.2 channel heights, step location x = 0.6. Determine whether the final result passes deterministic scientific validation.

objectives.description: Healthy, conservative transient solution at the registered horizon.

checks.rationale: The solver must exit normally at the execution horizon it was asked to reach.
Genuine fatal signatures only; the FOAM_SIGFPE start-up banner is excluded.
checkMesh must report Mesh OK.
The family is planar: exactly two solution directions.
Every meshing command must exit cleanly.
Realized cells must equal the specified block layout.
Inlet, outlet, symmetry planes, and obstacle must exist.
A cyclic patch would change the planar problem.
The spanwise direction must be empty.
Schemes, solution controls, and thermophysics equal the Foundation tutorial recipe.
The executed case equals the case frozen before execution.
Saved fields must contain no NaN or Inf.
Pressure, temperature, and density must be positive in saved states.
Positivity must also hold at every intermediate step.
The Courant history must be finite and positive.
The registered problem is supersonic inflow.
The imposed initial state must equal the specification to round-off.
Solid and symmetry boundaries pass no mass (floating-point scale).
Storage-aware discrete balance closes to round-off for this explicit update.
Each restart must continue the stored checkpoint mass.
A compression front must exist ahead of the step with a resolvable upstream state.
Direction-of-change test only; no magnitude is required.
Direction-of-change test only.
Direction-of-change test only.
The family's reference horizon t = 4 must be reached.

limitations: Normalized (dimensionless) quantities; no SI units implied.
Single-mesh verification; no mesh-independence or experimental validation claim.
Compression checks are directional, not a reference-field comparison.
